query:
WITH candidates AS (
            SELECT id, account_id, status_id FROM media_attachments
            WHERE file_name = $1 OR small_file_name = $1
            UNION
            SELECT m.id, m.account_id, m.status_id FROM media_attachments m
            JOIN video_compatibility_posters p ON p.media_id = m.id WHERE p.file_name = $1
            UNION
            SELECT m.id, m.account_id, m.status_id FROM media_attachments m
            JOIN video_drafts d ON d.media_id = m.id AND d.state = 'ready'
            JOIN native_video_hls_renditions r ON r.media_id = m.id AND r.generation = d.generation
            WHERE r.file_name = $1
            UNION
            SELECT m.id, m.account_id, m.status_id FROM media_attachments m
            JOIN video_drafts d ON d.media_id = m.id AND d.state = 'ready'
            JOIN video_storyboards b ON b.media_id = m.id AND b.generation = d.generation
            WHERE b.file_name = $1
            UNION
            SELECT m.id, m.account_id, m.status_id FROM media_attachments m
            JOIN media_hls_segments seg ON seg.media_id = m.id WHERE seg.cache_file = $1
        )
        SELECT ($1 NOT LIKE '%.draft.%' AND $1 NOT LIKE '%.livereplay.%' OR EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM candidates m
            JOIN public_native_videos v ON v.media_id = m.id
        )) AND ($1 !~ '^(hls|prog)[0-9a-f]{16}(\.[0-9a-f]{32})?\.mp4$' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM candidates))
        AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM media_cleanup_jobs WHERE file_name = $1)
        AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM accounts a
            WHERE a.suspended_at IS NOT NULL
              AND (a.avatar_file_name = $1 OR a.header_file_name = $1)
            UNION ALL
            SELECT 1 FROM candidates m
            JOIN accounts a ON a.id = m.account_id
            LEFT JOIN video_drafts d ON d.media_id = m.id
            LEFT JOIN native_live_sessions ls ON ls.replay_media_id = m.id
            LEFT JOIN video_publications v ON v.media_id = m.id AND v.status_id = m.status_id
            LEFT JOIN accounts c ON c.id = COALESCE(v.channel_id, d.channel_id)
            LEFT JOIN statuses s ON s.id = m.status_id
            LEFT JOIN remote_video_channels rv ON rv.status_id = m.status_id
            LEFT JOIN accounts rc ON rc.id = rv.channel_id
            WHERE a.suspended_at IS NOT NULL OR c.suspended_at IS NOT NULL
              OR rc.suspended_at IS NOT NULL OR rc.deleted_at IS NOT NULL
              OR (a.domain IS NOT NULL AND (NOT instance_domain_allowed(a.domain)
                  OR instance_domain_rejects_media(a.domain)))
              OR (rc.domain IS NOT NULL AND (NOT instance_domain_allowed(rc.domain)
                  OR instance_domain_rejects_media(rc.domain)))
              OR (v.media_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (
                  SELECT 1 FROM public_native_videos p WHERE p.media_id = m.id))
              OR (s.object_type = 'Video' AND (s.deleted_at IS NOT NULL
                  OR s.visibility NOT IN ('public', 'unlisted')))
              OR (d.media_id IS NOT NULL AND v.media_id IS NULL)
              OR (ls.replay_media_id IS NOT NULL AND v.media_id IS NULL)
        ) AS "allowed!"
        -- STUBKEEP: media denial inspects tombstones to revoke native Video bytes; ordinary attachment policy remains shared
